question: Does action-specific intervention evidence suppress false local structural repairs while preserving return-to-old-world retention and improving against strong equal-budget controls?
hypothesis: A two-action causal contrast requirement plus reversible per-context exception cells should reduce false promotions relative to CSRR-01 on stationary/noise controls, and improve changed-world predictive Brier over a frozen XOR baseline. Strong symbolic and windowed Bayesian controls may outperform it; no causal learning gain is presumed.

source_fixture.license: Original synthetic test code with no third-party data
source_fixture.public_observation: Binary (x,z) and chosen action a; binary consequence y after action. The phase/world true probability stays inside evaluator and sampling harness.
source_fixture.worlds: Six contiguous 256-step phases A B A C A B. Baseline y=a XOR x with P(agreement)=.9. B flips a=1,x=1,z=1; C flips a=1,x=0,z=1. Null world stays A for six phases. Same mechanism grammar, not independent unfamiliar source.
source_fixture.generator: sha256('csrr02:'+seed+':'+kind+':'+t+':'+(4*a+2*x+z)) first 32-bit integer divided by 2^32; compare to Bernoulli p
source_fixture.evaluation: Pre-action expected Bernoulli Brier on both actions for current public context, averaged equally; evaluator outcomes/phase/held risks never passed into model

frozen_design.split: Changed A B A C A B and independently generated null A A A A A A, each with six phases of 256 steps for each seed
frozen_design.ordering: For t=0..1535 in each sequence, public xz=(5*t+seed)%4, all policies see same public xz, and identical deterministic outcome for identical (seed,kind,t,a)
frozen_design.data_budget: 9216 synthetic consequences per policy (3 seeds * 6 phases * 256 steps * 2 changed/null worlds), 0 original-world actions
frozen_design.compute_budget: One Node.js v22 process for primary and one fresh-process deterministic reproduction, standard crypto/assert only; no GPU, no model API, no native runner
frozen_design.capacity: Paired repair: four context keys, two action histories capped at 12 bits each, exact original XOR base, four reversible local exception flags. Probe action0 until four witnesses, action1 until eight, then 3/4 action1; promote if action1 mismatch >=75% and action0 mismatch <=25%; revert if action1 mismatch <=25% or action0 unstable. All thresholds frozen.
frozen_design.evaluator: Analytic expected Bernoulli Brier across balanced a=0 and a=1 for current x,z before action, plus cold functional identity, false structural promotions, restored old drift and one synthetic action per learner per step

controls: Same paired-contrast mechanism under balanced passive action schedule (one action per step)
Exact CSRR-01 local rule repair on candidate's action and outcome stream, last 8 observations per cell
Per-context last-12 window likelihood-ratio Bayesian predictor on candidate action stream
Strong fully informed symbolic exception-locus comparator (z=1) on candidate action stream, never receives phase
Strong symbolic exception-locus comparator choosing action1 at every step, same action budget
Stationary null-world no-change control for false promotions
Malformed public input, bad consequence and checkpoint-integrity negative controls
metrics: Per-policy changed-world whole and changed-phase expected Brier
Changed-phase Brier gain against raw, passive, original CSRR-01, window Bayes and symbolic controls
Old-return mean Brier minus raw over phases 2 and 4 (<= +0.020)
Stationary null-world false promotions (must equal 0 for basic pass)
Cold snapshot and future prediction mismatches (must equal 0)
Exactly 9216 shared-equivalent synthetic observations and one action per model per step
Wall time, RSS, source SHA and non-use of protected source

classification_rules.engineering_advantage_dev_only: Basic passes AND changed-phase Brier improves >=.005 over EACH original CSRR-01, window Bayes, informed symbolic same-action and always-action1 symbolic control
classification_rules.mixed_dev_only: Changed-phase improvement >=.005 vs raw, return drift <=+.020, 0 stationary false promotions, 0 cold mismatches, equal action counts, but no >=.005 improvement over every strong control
classification_rules.negative_dev_only: Any basic predicate fails, or clear evidence of no useful effect, without violating test integrity
classification_rules.invalid: Unequal per-policy synthetic action budgets, evaluator/phase label leakage, failure of negative integrity checks, frozen protocol drift, source-first-use, or bad reproduction

prohibited_after_primary_run: Post-result thresholds, seeds, control selection or changes to source
Reuse of CSRR-01 consumed source observations as new evidence
Proclaiming native source/causal novelty or scientific improvement from synthetic fixture
Protected original-world use without owner lease
Promotion, merge, automation or runner execution
preregistration_note: Freeze study.mjs and this protocol as committed Git blobs before running any primary outcome. A separate later commit contains result and provenance. Source-free developer test cannot satisfy Yggdrasil G29/native acceptance.
